card.name: Words just before "predict" after a negation
card.fires_on: Small words or adverbs right after a negation like cannot, not, or no way, where "predict" or "predictable" is expected next. Seen in statements that something cannot be forecast.

modes.label: Before predict after cannot
modes.description: A verb or adverb slot after cannot or no one can, just ahead of predict or predicted.
modes.example: no seismologist in the world can<< accurately>> predict quakes.

modes.label: Before predictable after not
modes.description: An adverb or linking word after is not or is less, just ahead of predictable.
modes.example: the degree of response from a given dose is not<< precisely>> predictable.

card.writes: It promotes tokens that begin with "pre", which pushes the model to write predict or predictable next.
card.plain: It fires when a sentence says something cannot be predicted, just before the word predict appears.
